accepted_decisions.summary: CodeWiki distribution system prompt becomes the always-on OS contract for source truth, three-loop routing, gate semantics, generated/runtime boundaries, and daemon freshness rules.
The normal skill surface is exactly codewiki-decision, codewiki-planning, and codewiki-implementation.
Gateway/validation behavior is a gate/tool/runtime handoff contract, not a normal workflow skill or validation loop.
The generic codewiki router skill is removed from the normal skill surface; its invariant/routing content moves into the injected system prompt and package docs.
Removed skill surfaces should not be preserved as old commands, shims, aliases, hidden compatibility skills, or /skill:codewiki-validation.

Daemon/runtime should gain a Pi command-context worker-spawn bridge that launches fresh validator/worker sessions from CodeWiki source refs and blocks with exact content/platform reasons when unavailable.

row_to_kb_mappings.evidence: Extension and runtime docs now describe CodeWiki system-prompt/OS contract and fresh-worker boundary.
Adapter and file-structure docs now state normal workflow skills are decision/planning/implementation only and validation is gate/tool handoff, not a fourth skill.
Docs now route generic codewiki skill content to injected prompt/package docs and state removed skill surfaces should not be preserved as shims or aliases.
Runtime docs now require daemon to request fresh Pi worker sessions via command-context APIs and block on platform/content-evidence limits instead of self-approving.

product_impact: Users experience CodeWiki as a Pi software-development distribution with an always-on CodeWiki operating contract instead of loading a generic router skill.
User-facing skill discovery narrows to decision/planning/implementation; gateway validation runs through tools/fresh worker kickoff.
system_impact: Prompt contract must be expanded and corrected to three loops with gates, not a validation loop.
Package skill list and resource discovery must remove codewiki and codewiki-validation normal skill surfaces without compatibility shims.
Daemon/runtime needs a worker-spawn bridge through Pi command-context session APIs.
